## Checklist

- [ ] PR title follows [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) (see `CONTRIBUTING.md`)
- [ ] Green gate run locally: `gofmt`, `go vet ./...`, `golangci-lint run ./...`, `go test ./...`
- [ ] Tests added or updated for the change
- [ ] Docs updated if behavior, flags, or config changed
- [ ] One logical change per PR
